module_summary: Differential source-synchronous SDR input: converts differential clock and data pairs to single-ended via target buffers, then captures with an ssio_sdr_in child.

anchors.name: input_d_p
anchors.why: Positive leg of differential data input, buffered into input_d.

anchors.name: output_q
anchors.why: Captured single-data-rate output from the child SDR input register.

anchors.name: input_clk_p
anchors.why: Positive leg of differential forwarded clock, buffered into input_clk.

anchors.name: output_clk
anchors.why: Buffered receive clock output from the child.

anchors.name: input_d
anchors.why: Single-ended data after differential buffer, fed to the child.

anchors.name: input_clk
anchors.why: Single-ended clock after differential buffer, fed to the child.

groups.name: diff_input_buffers
groups.description: IBUFDS/ALT_INBUF_DIFF or passthrough converting differential pairs to single-ended.

groups.name: sdr_capture
groups.description: Child ssio_sdr_in buffering clock and registering data.
